mapper.select: SELECT * FROM record WHERE name LIKE concat('%',#{condition},'%') or phone LIKE concat('%',#{condition},'%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record (name, id_card, phone, source_address, trip_mode, return_time, train_number, remark) VALUES (#{name}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{sourceAddress}, #{tripMode}, #{returnTime}, #{trainNumber}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE record SET name = #{name}, id_card = #{idCard}, phone = #{phone}, source_address = #{sourceAddress}, trip_mode = #{tripMode}, train_number = #{trainNumber}, return_time = #{returnTime}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
